Definition
[Genuine nonlinearity and linear degeneracy] ↗ def:eigenvalue-eigenvector-notation-hyperbolic 1. ch11:11.2-def-2\group Conservation Laws

(i) The pair $(\lambda _k(z), r_k(z))$ is called genuinely nonlinear provided \[ (11) \qquad D\lambda _k(z)\cdot r_k(z) \neq 0 \quad \text{for all } z\in \mathbb {R}^m. \]

(ii) We say $(\lambda _k(z), r_k(z))$ is linearly degenerate if \[ (12) \qquad D\lambda _k(z)\cdot r_k(z) = 0 \quad \text{for all } z\in \mathbb {R}^m. \]
